author: kilo (CAM)
purpose: Decision-rule registry for autonomous CAM-drive replay. Every judgment call a human/Claude makes while driving Fusion 360 CAM is encoded here as a DETERMINISTIC rule (closed-form formula | ranked argmax | decision-table | threshold-with-fallback) the CAMDriveRecipeEngine evaluates with ZERO LLM. Referenced by stable id from recipe step.decisionRuleRef. Constants live in physics/constants.ts or the recipe header — NEVER inlined here (so the learning loop tunes by editing data, not code).

place.center_bbox.guard: fixture must be X/Y symmetric about table center (jawCenterXY=[0,0] for the MATE vise)

place.seat_bottom_riser.rationale: Part RAISED above the jaw top lip by a riser of extra material so finishing the overall height clears the jaws/parallels (no tool/holder collision). The [jawTopLipZ, jawTopLipZ+clearance] gap is sacrificial riser, removed in Op-2. SOURCE: operator rule 2026-05-31 [[feedback_setup_extra_material_fixture_clearance]].
place.seat_bottom_riser.guard: fixtureClearance >= finishing-tool+holder clearance above fixture; default 0.5in, tune larger for big-D holders / short tools
place.seat_bottom_riser.provenValue_UPSET: jawTopLipZ=5.63, clearance=0.5 -> part bottom Z=6.13 (bbox Z[6.13,10.74])

parting.geometry_driven.algorithm: largest-flat-face-Z-or-midheight: among faces with normal +/-Z, pick max-area; if area >= AREA_FRAC*bboxFootprint -> partingZ = that face Z; ELSE partingZ = bboxMinZ + 0.5*(bboxMaxZ-bboxMinZ) (mid-height fallback)
parting.geometry_driven.output: partingZ (inch) — Op-1 machines above this + side walls down to it; below stays gripped for Op-2
parting.geometry_driven.guard: partingZ STRICTLY interior: minZ < z < maxZ (a face AT a boundary is the top/bottom face, not a parting plane). NEVER at/below part bottom (riser/jaws). On AREA_FRAC miss or mid-height fallback -> needsOperatorConfirm=true, which the engine turns into a forced gate_to_operator before any actuation.
parting.geometry_driven.provenValue_UPSET: operator interpretation 'top half' -> mid-height fallback partingZ=8.435 (fixture) / part-local 2.305

stock.oversize.output: fixed-box stock dims (inch). bottom=0 because the seated/riser face is the Z reference
stock.oversize.guard: stock must not intersect fixture below the seated face; radial may grow per 'oversize on length to avoid jaws' policy

wcs.stock_bottom_center.provenValue_UPSET: (0, 0, 5.63) fixture coords = jaw top lip / stock bottom

strategy.by_feature.guard: bore_large iff diameter within boring-bar range (L/D feasible per tool lib); else bore_small. catalogOperation per entry validated by gate.catalog_validate.
strategy.by_feature.rationale: static decision-table keyed on feature class; entries re-ranked by the learning loop via outcomes (no code change). Op-1 chain proven on UP SET.

tool.spindle_match.filter: holder.taper == machine.spindle.taper AND holder.interface includes machine.spindle.interface
tool.spindle_match.provenValue_UPSET: machine spindle = CAT40 BIG-PLUS -> filter to BIG-PLUS CAT40 holders (upset-h13-bigplus-cat40-tools.json)

inputs: spindle-matched candidates feasible for feature (DC fits width, LB reaches depth+clearance)
tool.rank_costeff_mrr.definitions: MRR = chipLoad*DC*ap*feed ; deflection = F*L^3/(3*E*I) (canonical constants.ts) ; costEff = toolLife / toolCost
tool.rank_costeff_mrr.rationale: makes 'maximize cost-eff x MRR' a concrete reproducible argmax

feed.kienzle.constantsRef: constants.ts MATERIAL_DB ISO group H (H13): kc1_1=3200, mc per table; apply annealed-H13 derate multiplier from constants (~0.8, hot-work)
feed.kienzle.guard: NEVER inline kc1.1/mc — reference constants.ts. H13 annealed = ISO P-behavior derate but H-group base; verify MATERIAL_DB entry.

feed.taylor_vc.formula: T = (C/Vc)^(1/n)  ->  Vc = C / T^n  for target tool life T
feed.taylor_vc.constantsRef: constants.ts Taylor C,n for coating/material pair (H13: C~350, n~0.25)

feed.chipload_rpm.formula: rpm = Vc*1000/(pi*Dmm) [inch-convert for Okuma] ; vf = rpm*fz*flutes
inputs: fz seed from tool start-values presets
feed.chipload_rpm.output: spindle rpm + feed vf (IN/MIN — unit-suffixed expression for the inch doc)
feed.chipload_rpm.guard: clamp fz to physics max: spindle power Pc = Fc*Vc/60000 <= machine.max_power_kw. EMIT feeds as inch expressions ('14 in/min'), NOT mm CAM_PARAM_MAP x0.1 (the 10x feed-bug).

feed.deflection_clamp.formula: if delta = F*L^3/(3*E*I) > params.DEFL_TOL -> reduce ap/fz by bisection until within tol (capped iters)
feed.deflection_clamp.guard: deterministic bisection, capped iterations; tol per tolerance class (.001 part -> tighter)

gate.catalog_validate.guard: MANDATORY before op_create + post (recipe step.gate.required=true). Already enforced inside cam_drive_create_operation. NO judgment — pure validation against grounded catalog. allowUnknownParams advisory (catalogs ~55-59% complete).
